findings.summary: Absolute stop |x(s)-u|<1e-12 exits on initial guess for u<=1e-12; x1=x2=0,y1=y2=1,u=1e-12 gives 3e-12 vs ref 3e-4 (30x tol)
No valid x1=1.0 case; hand mutant M1 (half-open x1 range) survives; out-of-range cases are coarse (+-0.01)
Uniform u, 256 cases: misses C1 and M2 (X_EPSILON 1e-6) survives; needs log-scale u near 0/1 and pinned counterexample
u outside [0,1]/NaN clamp untested; M5 (NaN->1) survives
Spec silent on apply for u outside [0,1], NaN and invalid CubicBezier; specifier should record deviation (2) or mark unspecified
Hull clamp removal and Newton bracket guard removal survive tests and probes; likely equivalent, documented
